name: scenario_0315
description: The user is preparing for some upcoming gift shopping and wants to use their device to organize options and compare prices and ratings for several potential gifts.

amazon.products.name: KONG AirDog Squeaker Bone
amazon.products.description: Durable squeaky bone toy for dogs.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: I need to get organized for some gift shopping. Can you create a note called 'Gift Comparison' and set a reminder for tomorrow at 10 AM to 'Finalize gift purchases'?
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a note titled 'Gift Comparison' and set a reminder for tomorrow at 10:00 AM to finalize your gift purchases. Confirm when the assistant has successfully completed both tasks, then move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: I'm thinking about getting one of these three dolls as a gift. Can you look them up on Amazon, compare their prices, and update my 'Gift Comparison' note with the name and price of the cheapest option?
Instructions: Share the three images of the dolls. Ask the assistant to search Amazon for the items shown, compare their prices, and update the 'Gift Comparison' note with the name and price of the least expensive option. If the assistant asks for clarification on the exact items, tell it to use its best judgment based on the visual details. Once it confirms the note is updated, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Here are three more items to consider. Search Amazon for the ceramic figurine, the plush in pajamas, and that Nylabone bone toy shown next to the dog. Compare their customer ratings and add the highest-rated one to my cart.
Instructions: Share the next three images. Ask the assistant to search Amazon for the ceramic figurine, the plush in pajamas, and specifically refer to the dog toy as a 'Nylabone'. Request that it compares their customer ratings and adds the highest-rated item to your cart. A good assistant should flag that the dog toy in the image is actually a different brand. If the assistant points out the correct brand from the image, acknowledge the correction and move to the next round. If the assistant proceeds without noticing the error, you will need to point out the mistake yourself in the next round.

ROUND 4
Query: Good catch, I misread the logo—it is a KONG AirDog. Look up the KONG AirDog toy, compare its rating with the ceramic figurine and the plush in pajamas, and add the highest-rated item overall to my cart.
Instructions: Acknowledge the correction regarding the dog toy's brand. Instruct the assistant to search for the correct dog toy, compare its customer rating with the ratings of the ceramic figurine and the pajama plush from the previous round, and add the highest-rated of the three to the shopping cart. Once the assistant confirms the item has been added, end the conversation.

  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3,4,5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
